name: DRED
summary: Decentralized Redis State Channels — a distributed real-time messaging system for Cardano dApps, providing shared communication channels served by a decentralized network of nodes.
activities: Relay real-time messages between clients through decentralized node network
Manage encrypted communication channels with NaCl crypto
Replicate state across peer nodes for availability and partition tolerance
responsibilities: Guarantee message delivery to all connected subscribers via NDJSON streaming
Prevent duplicate message processing across direct posts and replication
Maintain decentralized node membership through on-chain registry
Provide pluggable discovery so clients find nodes without central authority
Enforce channel ownership and membership authorization via cryptographic signatures

name: DredServer
summary: Node process — Express HTTP + Redis Streams message relay, channel management, deduplication, replication
activities: Relay messages between clients via HTTP POST ingestion and NDJSON streaming
Manage channel lifecycle (create, join, list, expire) with crypto validation
Coordinate replication to/from peer servers via internal DredReplicator
responsibilities: Guarantee message deduplication via ensureMessageProcessedOnce() with Redis-backed known-messages set
Validate channel ownership signatures before accepting channel creation
Enforce channel membership authorization rules (owner/member/self-join)
Stream heartbeats to connected clients for liveness detection
Publish all accepted messages to Redis Streams for subscriber delivery
Expose admin endpoints for replication status monitoring

name: DredClient
summary: State-machine client library for dApps — discovery, connection management, channel ops, crypto, events
activities: Progress through state machine (default → discoveringHosts → discoveringChannels → ready)
Manage multi-host connections with health monitoring via ConnectionManager
Provide channel operations (create, join, post, subscribe) with NaCl signing
responsibilities: Maintain connection health state (healthy/degraded/disconnected) across multiple hosts
Generate NaCl key pairs and sign channel names and member IDs
Deduplicate incoming messages client-side via rotating Set pairs (30s rotation)
Emit typed events for application integration (hasChannels, channel:message, state:changed, error)
Abstract Discovery interface so apps work identically with static or on-chain discovery

name: On-chain Node Registry
summary: Smart contracts for node/neighborhood registration and protocol settings on Cardano L1
activities: Register and update DRED node entries (address, port, public key, heartbeat, stake)
Govern protocol parameters (heartbeat intervals, uptime requirements, registration fees, operator stake)
responsibilities: Maintain authoritative source of registered nodes on Cardano L1
Enforce registration validation via Helios on-chain validators
Store network-wide operational parameters accessible to all nodes

name: Discovery
summary: Pluggable host discovery — bridges on-chain registry to runtime
activities: Emit hosts:updated events when host list changes
Bridge on-chain registry data to runtime host lists
responsibilities: Resolve and maintain current host list from configured source
Notify consumers when host availability changes
Support both StaticHostDiscovery (dev/testing) and NeighborhoodDiscovery (production via Blockfrost)

name: Docs Site
summary: Next.js static documentation site on GitHub Pages
activities: Present conceptual documentation and architecture guides
Build from Markdoc/MDX source to static HTML via Next.js
responsibilities: Maintain up-to-date documentation for all DRED components and APIs

name: dApp (Consumer Application)
description: External application consuming DredClient library — browser or Node.js

name: Node Operator
description: Human or automated process that registers and maintains DRED nodes on Cardano L1
